title: Click, then stay
the_thought: He made the click, then he made them stay.
hook: A giant bright poster leans on a paint table.

levels.name: The Short
beats: No letters on it. Then a couch that does not empty. He made the click, then he made them stay. YouTube told everyone the machine wanted a tap, then a sit. Most people only painted the door. He painted the door, then built a room people would not leave. A hungry machine eats two foods. First food is the click. Second food is sitting still. Watch the count chair. Watch the expensive true poster. That pair is the crack. Not a stolen password. A diet, cooked on purpose.
